github.name: GitHub
github.archived.body: {repository} is archived on GitHub. You can clone and design, but can’t push changes.
github.blocked.sso.body: {repository} belongs to an organization that requires SSO. Authorize your GitHub account for it.
github.blocked.approval.body: {repository} belongs to an organization that hasn’t approved Onlook yet.
github.connected: Connected. Onlook can see the repositories you can access.
github.connect.body: GitHub opens in your browser, where you choose the repositories Onlook can see.
github.connecting: Finish connecting in your browser, then return here.
github.noConnection: GitHub isn’t connected, so Onlook can’t list your repositories. Connecting opens GitHub in your browser.
github.reconnect.body: To access your repositories, reconnect GitHub.
github.approval.body: GitHub denied access. Review your repository permissions.
github.rateLimited: GitHub received too many requests. Try again later.
github.tokenLifetime: GitHub couldn’t provide temporary access. Try again later.
github.unavailable: GitHub is unavailable. Try again later.
github.connectionFailed: GitHub couldn’t complete the connection. Try again later.
github.waiting.body: Your organization needs to approve access. Onlook checks again when you return.
github.empty: No repositories are available. Check your GitHub access and your organization’s approval.
github.existing: The {repository} repository is already on this computer. You can open your existing workspace instead of cloning again.
github.slow: Still cloning. Large repositories take longer.
github.error.network: The connection dropped. Try cloning again.
github.error.access: GitHub access changed. Review your permissions.
github.error.disk: Not enough space to clone this repository. Free up space and try again.
github.error.empty: This branch has no commits. Choose another repository.
github.error.destination: Onlook couldn’t open the folder it saves clones to. Try again.
github.error.existing: Onlook couldn’t check the projects already on this computer. Try again.
github.error.cleanup: Onlook couldn’t remove the unfinished copy. It’s removed the next time you open Onlook.
github.error.unknown: The clone didn’t finish. Try again.
